body.name: Fixed-law certified value-image elimination
body.construction: For fixed rational or real-algebraic \(p\), \(\mu\), and \(\pi\), apply \(\mathsf{CAD}_\eta\) to the first-order real formula \(\exists q\,[q\in\mathcal K(p)\wedge v=V_\pi(q)]\); isolate every real boundary root exactly, or stop root isolation after disjoint rational intervals of width at most \(\eta\) have been certified.
